home.aboutTitle: Personal training with a longevity mindset
home.aboutP1: BonaFIT is close, unhurried coaching for people who want to stay strong, mobile and independent.
home.aboutP2: We work with precision and respect for your body. The goal is simple: more ease in the day you already live.
home.quote: “We don’t train a number. We train so you can keep living your life with strength.”
home.slogan: Age is not trained. Strength is.
home.offerLede: One-to-one sessions at home in the Bonalba area.
home.complementsText: Optional care for recovery, tone and how your body feels between sessions.
home.longevityTitle: Strength that supports a longer, fuller life
home.longevityText: A BonaFIT programme is measured in how you feel and move: strength, confidence and ease in the life you already live.
home.areaTitle: Near you, where looking after your body feels natural
home.areaLede: Based in Bonalba and nearby Mutxamel, with travel to neighbouring towns when it fits.

offers.title: Sessions that fit you
offers.text: About an hour, designed for your body and goals. Two sessions a week is a steady pace. Progress without rushing.

offers.title: Clear starting point
offers.text: We begin with a calm assessment, listen carefully, then build a programme that evolves as you do.

offers.title: A body that supports you
offers.text: Strength, mobility, balance and useful movement, with follow-up so every session has a reason.

outcomes: Muscle mass tends to decline with age (sarcopenia); progressive resistance training helps slow that loss.
Systematic reviews show strength training improves muscle strength and physical function across adult ages.
International consensus on sarcopenia (EWGSOP) places resistance exercise at the core of prevention and care.
Stronger muscle supports balance, metabolic health and the ease of everyday movement.
Short, consistent sessions add up: more capacity for the life you want to keep living.
